mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, which consistently generates positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC remains <0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 5.0% signals labor market tightening, increasing corporate profit expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or Rank IC <0.03 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real sales (RSAFS) above 12-month moving averages indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 12-month MA
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month MA, or interaction Rank IC <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation rate exceeding 2.0% signals rising price pressures, prompting monetary tightening that increases discount rates and generates negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when CPI inflation > 2.0%, or Rank IC <0.04 over 5-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS rise) and unemployment decline (UNRATE fall) signal labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or interaction Rank IC <0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 indicates sustained manufacturing output, supporting corporate profit growth and generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC <0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 550.0 signals strong consumer confidence in durable goods, accelerating economic growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in >60% of instances when HOUST > 550.0, or Rank IC <0.04 over 5-year windows.
